structuredResult.summary: Confirmed defect: LinkBook.resolve currently expires links only when now is after expiresAt, so equality incorrectly resolves and may increment analytics. Required boundary: a link is expired when now is equal to or after expiresAt; such resolution returns Optional.empty() and changes neither total nor UTC daily counts. Preserve behavior before expiry, null expiry, record=false, missing/disabled/deleted links, immutable destinations, permanent code reservation, retained counts, UTC buckets, the POM, and supplied acceptance tests. This requirements-only pass made no files or source changes.
risks: The declared write scope is limited to artifacts/requirements/, so repairing src/main/java/demo/LinkBook.java requires a later execution authorization with that source path allowed.
Downstream verification should run the supplied Maven acceptance suite without changing pom.xml verification configuration; no independent Maven verification is claimed here.

tasks.description: Record the approved repair requirement and observable acceptance criteria: resolve succeeds before expiresAt; at exactly expiresAt and afterward it returns empty and does not increment total or UTC daily counts; all other LinkBook behavior, pom.xml, and supplied tests remain unchanged. The intended source correction is to treat non-null expiry as expired whenever now is not before expiresAt.

exportNote: Original evidence hashes refer to private originals retained locally; this redacted export has its own checksum in MANIFEST.json.
